messages:
olivia: Quick announce: we9re switching artifact storage for CI builds from internal S3 buckets to the new artifact-registry service (registry.redwood-internal) starting 2026-09-01 00:00 UTC. Migration window ~48h.

harry: Why the move? Registry gives dedup, immutable manifests, retention policies, and integrated attestation. Also simplifies cross-region replication.

samir: What breaks? Build jobs that push to s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/* will need to use the registry CLI or the new Gradle/Maven plugin. Download URLs will change.

olivia: We9re providing compatibility: a proxy endpoint that maps old S3 URLs to registry manifests for 14 days post-cutover, but owners should update links.

artifact-bot: SCAN: found 132 workflows writing to s3://redwood-ci-artifacts. List has been uploaded to the migration doc.

beth: Example migration for a Docker push with new CLI:
```
# old: aws s3 cp image.tar s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/$BUILD_ID/
registry-cli push --file image.tar --repo docker/images --tag $GIT_SHA
```

harry: Auth changes: CI workflows must use the registry OIDC token or the new registry-action. Service accounts that used kms-encrypted s3 keys must be updated to allow registry-pusher@redwood-internal.

olivia: Canary plan: infra/* -> internal-tools/* -> product/* -> external. First canary: 2026-09-01 02:00 UTC with infra/ci-utils, monitor 90m for upload/download errors and checksum mismatches.

samir: Rollback knobs?

infra-oncall: If significant errors appear, we can flip org flag to route uploads back to S3 proxy (read-only for manifests older than cutover) and pause the registry service via feature flag. Emergency process: page infra-oncall -> samir -> olivia.

beth: Update to artifact URL format example (consumers must change fetch): `https://registry.redwood-internal/v1/repos/docker/images/manifests/$GIT_SHA`

artifact-bot: POLICY: New retention defaults: artifacts older than 90 days will be auto-expired unless a "retain" tag is present. Please tag long-term artifacts.

harry: Migration checklist (short): 1) update push steps to registry-cli/action, 2) grant IAM role registry-pusher to CI identities, 3) run canary push, 4) validate download URLs and checksums, 5) mark repo migrated in spreadsheet.

olivia: We9ll publish transformation scripts for common languages (npm, maven, pip) and a small proxy library to translate old S3 GET semantics. Doc + PR template in #devex in 1hr.

samir: Owners: please run a dry-run using the registry-cli `--dry-run` flag by EOD 2026-08-28. If you can9t meet that date, open an exception ticket.

beth: Note for release engineers: the release tooling reads artifact URLs from release metadata. Update the release generator to emit new manifest URLs.

olivia: Thanks all. I9ll post the migration doc link here when ready. Tag @olivia/@harry for urgent issues during the window. :ship:
